verdict.rationale: Undermind generates AI insights inside the product. It writes syntheses of literature reviews, answers questions across full-text PDFs in the workspace (including uploaded paywalled papers), offers a brainstorming AI expert, builds custom tables, and sends tailored alerts on saved topics. Community users confirm it returns ranked, annotated results and gives a comprehensive understanding of a topic. Missing for 10: evidence of insights over non-literature user data, and independent hands-on corroboration of analysis of the user's own uploaded documents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers specific questions across many papers at once, including from figures, tables, and equations.
